summary: Frontend-only verification of the Google client_id crash fix on /login and /registration. Confirmed both pages render without any 'Missing required parameter client_id' runtime overlay and Google button is rendered but DISABLED (opacity-50, disabled attribute) via GoogleButtonDisabled component when REACT_APP_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID is empty. Email/password login/register flows could NOT be end-to-end tested because the backend is DOWN (Postgres at 127.0.0.1:5432 not running, so /api/health returns 502 and uvicorn startup fails with ConnectionRefusedError).

critical.issue: Backend uvicorn cannot start – asyncpg ConnectionRefusedError to 127.0.0.1:5432. PostgreSQL is not installed/running in the pod (no postgres binary, /var/run/postgresql missing, dpkg has no postgresql package). All API calls (login, register, health, market) return 502 through preview URL.

integration_issues.issue: Login submit shows 'Login failed - The origin web server returned an invalid or incomplete response to Cloudflare' toast because backend is 502 (root cause = Postgres not running, not a frontend bug)
Not tested end-to-end (blocked by backend outage); registration form itself renders correctly with country, email, password, TOS checkbox, and disabled Google button.

verified_fixes: /login: NO runtime error overlay, NO 'Missing required parameter client_id' text on page.
/registration: NO runtime error overlay, NO client_id error text.
Login Google button: <button data-testid='login-google-button' disabled title='Google login is not configured' class='...opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed'> – confirmed via DOM query.
Registration Google button: rendered visually disabled (grey, not clickable) with same GoogleButtonDisabled component.
No pageerrors captured on either page during load.

critical_code_review_comments: App uses PostgreSQL + Redis but the Emergent pod doesn't ship those services by default (supervisor only runs backend/frontend/mongodb). The repo needs an in-pod install script or supervisor entries for postgres/redis, otherwise the backend cannot run in this environment.
GoogleButton.jsx correctly guards useGoogleLogin behind GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID check – good defensive pattern.
frontend/.env exposes REACT_APP_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID='' (blank) – acceptable; disabled state works as intended.

rca of the issue: Root cause of login E2E failure: PostgreSQL server absent in pod → asyncpg ConnectionRefusedError on backend startup → uvicorn exits → k8s ingress returns 502 → frontend shows generic 'Login failed / Cloudflare invalid response' toast. Reproduction: `curl http://127.0.0.1:8001/api/health` → connection refused; `sudo supervisorctl restart backend` → err.log shows Postgres connect fail. Mitigation: install & start postgres (bfg_admin/bfg_local_pw/binaryfund) + redis; run /app/backend/seed.py to seed admin + 28 instruments.
